content: SigNoz ingestion via standard OTLP: set OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT, OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_HEADERS (ingestion key if cloud; self-hosted needs none), OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_PROTOCOL=http/protobuf or grpc, OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES for service.name. Works with any standard OTel SDK, no SigNoz-specific SDK needed.
